verse.verse_1: By those who set the ranks in battle order
verse.verse_2: And those who drive away (the wicked) with reproof
verse.verse_3: And those who read (the Word) for a reminder,
verse.verse_4: Lo! thy Lord is surely One;
verse.verse_5: Lord of the heavens and of the earth and all that is between them, and Lord of the sun's risings.
verse.verse_6: Lo! We have adorned the lowest heaven with an ornament, the planets;
verse.verse_7: With security from every froward devil.
verse.verse_8: They cannot listen to the Highest Chiefs for they are pelted from every side,
verse.verse_9: Outcast, and theirs is a perpetual torment;
verse.verse_10: Save him who snatcheth a fragment, and there pursueth him a piercing flame.
verse.verse_11: Then ask them (O Muhammad): Are they stronger as a creation, or those (others) whom we have created? Lo! We created them of plastic clay.
verse.verse_12: Nay, but thou dost marvel when they mock
verse.verse_13: And heed not when they are reminded,
verse.verse_14: And seek to scoff when they behold a portent.
verse.verse_15: And they say: Lo! this is mere magic;
verse.verse_16: When we are dead and have become dust and bones, shall we then, forsooth, be raised (again)?
verse.verse_18: Say (O Muhammad): Ye, in truth; and ye will be brought low.
verse.verse_19: There is but one Shout, and lo! they behold,
verse.verse_20: And say: Ah, woe for us! This is the Day of Judgment.
verse.verse_21: This is the Day of Separation, which ye used to deny.
verse.verse_22: (And it is said unto the angels): Assemble those who did wrong, together with their wives and what they used to worship
verse.verse_23: Instead of Allah, and lead them to the path to hell;
verse.verse_24: And stop them, for they must be questioned.
verse.verse_25: What aileth you that ye help not one another?
verse.verse_26: Nay, but this day they make full submission.
verse.verse_27: And some of them draw near unto others, mutually questioning.
verse.verse_28: They say: Lo! ye used to come unto us, imposing, (swearing that ye spoke the truth).
verse.verse_29: They answer: Nay, but ye (yourselves) were not believers.
verse.verse_30: We had no power over you, but ye were wayward folk.
verse.verse_31: Now the Word of our Lord hath been fulfilled concerning us. Lo! we are about to taste (the doom).
verse.verse_32: Thus we misled you. Lo! we were (ourselves) astray.
verse.verse_33: Then lo! this day they (both) are sharers in the doom.
verse.verse_34: Lo! thus deal We with the guilty.
verse.verse_35: For when it was said unto them, There is no Allah save Allah, they were scornful
verse.verse_36: And said: Shall we forsake our gods for a mad poet?
verse.verse_37: Nay, but he brought the Truth, and he confirmed those sent (before him).
verse.verse_38: Lo! (now) verily ye taste the painful doom -
verse.verse_39: Ye are requited naught save what ye did -
verse.verse_41: For them there is a known provision,
verse.verse_42: Fruits. And they will be honoured
verse.verse_45: A cup from a gushing spring is brought round for them,
verse.verse_47: Wherein there is no headache nor are they made mad thereby.
verse.verse_48: And with them are those of modest gaze, with lovely eyes,
verse.verse_49: (Pure) as they were hidden eggs (of the ostrich).
verse.verse_50: And some of them draw near unto others, mutually questioning.
verse.verse_51: A speaker of them saith: Lo! I had a comrade
verse.verse_52: Who used to say: Art thou in truth of those who put faith (in his words)?
verse.verse_53: Can we, when we are dead and have become mere dust and bones - can we (then) verily be brought to book?
verse.verse_55: Then looketh he and seeth him in the depth of hell.
verse.verse_56: He saith: By Allah, thou verily didst all but cause my ruin,
verse.verse_57: And had it not been for the favour of my Lord, I too had been of those haled forth (to doom).
verse.verse_58: Are we then not to die
verse.verse_59: Saving our former death, and are we not to be punished?
verse.verse_60: Lo! this is the supreme triumph.
verse.verse_61: For the like of this, then, let the workers work.
verse.verse_62: Is this better as a welcome, or the tree of Zaqqum?
verse.verse_63: Lo! We have appointed it a torment for wrong-doers.
verse.verse_64: Lo! it is a tree that springeth in the heart of hell.
verse.verse_65: Its crop is as it were the heads of devils
verse.verse_66: And lo! they verily must eat thereof, and fill (their) bellies therewith.
verse.verse_67: And afterward, lo! thereupon they have a drink of boiling water
verse.verse_68: And afterward, lo! their return is surely unto hell.
verse.verse_69: They indeed found their fathers astray,
verse.verse_70: But they make haste (to follow) in their footsteps.
verse.verse_71: And verily most of the men of old went astray before them,
verse.verse_72: And verily We sent among them warners.
verse.verse_73: Then see the nature of the consequence for those warned,
verse.verse_75: And Noah verily prayed unto Us, and gracious was the Hearer of his prayer
verse.verse_76: And We saved him and his household from the great distress,
verse.verse_77: And made his seed the survivors,
verse.verse_78: And left for him among the later folk (the salutation):
verse.verse_79: Peace be unto Noah among the peoples!
verse.verse_80: Lo! thus do We reward the good.
verse.verse_81: Lo! he is one of Our believing slaves.
verse.verse_82: Then We did drown the others.
verse.verse_83: And lo! of his persuasion verily was Abraham
verse.verse_84: When he came unto his Lord with a whole heart;
verse.verse_85: When he said unto his father and his folk: What is it that ye worship?
verse.verse_86: Is it a falsehood - gods beside Allah - that ye desire?
verse.verse_87: What then is your opinion of the Lord of the Worlds?
verse.verse_88: And he glanced a glance at the stars
verse.verse_89: Then said: Lo! I feel sick!
verse.verse_90: And they turned their backs and went away from him.
verse.verse_91: Then turned he to their gods and said: Will ye not eat?
verse.verse_92: What aileth you that ye speak not?
verse.verse_93: Then he attacked them, striking with his right hand.
verse.verse_94: And (his people) came toward him, hastening.
verse.verse_95: He said: Worship ye that which ye yourselves do carve
verse.verse_96: When Allah hath created you and what ye make?
verse.verse_97: They said: Build for him a building and fling him in the red-hotfire.
verse.verse_98: And they designed a snare for him, but We made them the undermost.
verse.verse_99: And he said: Lo! I am going unto my Lord Who will guide me.
verse.verse_100: My Lord! Vouchsafe me of the righteous.
verse.verse_101: So We gave him tidings of a gentle son.
verse.verse_102: And when (his son) was old enough to walk with him, (Abraham) said: O my dear son, I have seen in a dream that I must sacrifice thee. So look, what thinkest thou? He said: O my father! Do that which thou art commanded. Allah willing, thou shalt find me of the steadfast.
verse.verse_103: Then, when they had both surrendered (to Allah), and he had flung him down upon his face,
verse.verse_104: We called unto him: O Abraham!
verse.verse_105: Thou hast already fulfilled the vision. Lo! thus do We reward the good.
verse.verse_106: Lo! that verily was a clear test.
verse.verse_107: Then We ransomed him with a tremendous victim.
verse.verse_108: And We left for him among the later folk (the salutation):
verse.verse_110: Thus do We reward the good.
verse.verse_111: Lo! he is one of Our believing slaves.
verse.verse_112: And we gave him tidings of the birth of Isaac, a prophet of the righteous.
verse.verse_113: And We blessed him and Isaac. And of their seed are some who do good, and some who plainly wrong themselves.
verse.verse_114: And We verily gave grace unto Moses and Aaron,
verse.verse_115: And saved them and their people from the great distress,
verse.verse_116: And helped them so that they became the victors.
verse.verse_117: And We gave them the clear Scripture
verse.verse_118: And showed them the right path.
verse.verse_119: And We left for them among the later folk (the salutation):
verse.verse_120: Peace be unto Moses and Aaron!
verse.verse_121: Lo! thus do We reward the good.
verse.verse_122: Lo! they are two of Our believing slaves.
verse.verse_123: And lo! Elias was of those sent (to warn),
verse.verse_124: When he said unto his folk: Will ye not ward off (evil)?
verse.verse_125: Will ye cry unto Baal and forsake the Best of creators,
verse.verse_126: Allah, your Lord and Lord of your forefathers?
verse.verse_127: But they denied him, so they surely will be haled forth (to the doom)
verse.verse_129: And we left for him among the later folk (the salutation):
verse.verse_131: Lo! thus do We reward the good.
verse.verse_132: Lo! he is one of our believing slaves.
verse.verse_133: And lo! Lot verily was of those sent (to warn).
verse.verse_134: When We saved him and his household, every one,
verse.verse_135: Save an old woman among those who stayed behind;
verse.verse_137: And lo! ye verily pass by (the ruin of) them in the morning
verse.verse_138: And at night-time; have ye then no sense?
verse.verse_139: And lo! Jonah verily was of those sent (to warn)
verse.verse_140: When he fled unto the laden ship,
verse.verse_141: And then drew lots and was of those rejected;
verse.verse_142: And the fish swallowed him while he was blameworthy;
verse.verse_143: And had he not been one of those who glorify (Allah)
verse.verse_144: He would have tarried in its belly till the day when they are raised;
verse.verse_145: Then We cast him on a desert shore while he was sick;
verse.verse_146: And We caused a tree of gourd to grow above him;
verse.verse_147: And We sent him to a hundred thousand (folk) or more
verse.verse_148: And they believed, therefor We gave them comfort for a while.
verse.verse_149: Now ask them (O Muhammad): Hath thy Lord daughters whereas they have sons?
verse.verse_150: Or created We the angels females while they were present?
verse.verse_151: Lo! it is of their falsehood that they say:
verse.verse_152: Allah hath begotten. Allah! verily they tell a lie.
verse.verse_153: (And again of their falsehood): He hath preferred daughters to sons.
verse.verse_154: What aileth you? How judge ye?
verse.verse_156: Or have ye a clear warrant?
verse.verse_157: Then produce your writ, if ye are truthful.
verse.verse_158: And they imagine kinship between him and the jinn, whereas the jinn know well that they will be brought before (Him).
verse.verse_159: Glorified be Allah from that which they attribute (unto Him),
verse.verse_161: Lo! verily, ye and that which ye worship,
verse.verse_163: Save him who is to burn in hell.
verse.verse_164: There is not one of us but hath his known position.
verse.verse_165: Lo! we, even we are they who set the ranks,
verse.verse_166: Lo! we, even we are they who hymn His praise
verse.verse_167: And indeed they used to say:
verse.verse_168: If we had but a reminder from the men of old
verse.verse_169: We would be single-minded slaves of Allah.
verse.verse_170: Yet (now that it is come) they disbelieve therein; but they will come to know.
verse.verse_171: And verily Our word went forth of old unto Our bondmen sent (to warn)
verse.verse_172: That they verily would be helped,
verse.verse_173: And that Our host, they verily would be the victors.
verse.verse_174: So withdraw from them (O Muhammad) awhile,
verse.verse_175: And watch, for they will (soon) see.
verse.verse_176: Would they hasten on Our doom?
verse.verse_177: But when it cometh home to them, then it will be a hapless morn for those who have been warned.
verse.verse_179: And watch, for they will (soon) see.
verse.verse_180: Glorified be thy Lord, the Lord of Majesty, from that which they attribute (unto Him)
verse.verse_181: And peace be unto those sent (to warn).
verse.verse_182: And praise be to Allah, Lord of the Worlds!
